_doc: Per character and skin (kitchen | home): backend static | sprite | spine. sprite: index = anim2d/<char>/index.json, generated by tools/build_anim2d.py from art/anim2d/<char>_<action>/ (rerun after art updates, no code change). use = actions allowed for the skin; carries = held items already painted into carry_* frames. Missing actions fall back to idle, then static.
